pair_goal50.json.what: the solve_integrals output at goal 50 of the reference pair

pair_goal70.json.what: the solve_integrals output at goal 70 of the reference pair

pair_compare_previous.out.what: the reading of that pair by an earlier version of the tool without the numerical-zero and window rules (OVERALL FAIL)

pair_q1b_goal30.json.what: the solve_integrals output at goal 30 of the second pair (98 integrals of one family; the im parts of real coefficients are numerical zeros)

pair_q1b_goal60.json.what: the solve_integrals output at goal 60 of the second pair

pair_goal50.config.json.what: the amflow_cli input config of the goal-50 member of the reference pair (goal_digits 50), re-cut: every string value that carries a machine path replaced by <re-cut> and the producer bookkeeping block removed

pair_goal70.config.json.what: the amflow_cli input config of the goal-70 member of the reference pair (goal_digits 70), re-cut likewise

pair_radii_only_previous.out.what: the no-goal reading of the reference pair (the zero threshold from the two radii alone: OVERALL FAIL), which --radii-only reproduces byte for byte

_note: sha256 of each fixture; _vendored_from names the source object's sha256 (recut false = identical bytes; recut true = the two configs, whose machine paths are replaced by <re-cut> and whose producer bookkeeping block is removed, with goal_digits kept and the re-cut fields listed)
